name: NVIDIA NVLink-C2C product page
notes: Chip-to-chip interconnect page: NVLink-C2C extends NVLink to die-to-die, spanning PCB, MCM and interposer integration; 6x energy efficiency and 3.5x area efficiency vs a PCIe Gen6 PHY on NVIDIA silicon; products using it are Grace Hopper, GB200 Superchip and Vera Rubin Superchip.
